definitions.gloss: developing new business; new market development; finding new customers
definitions.explanation: The activity of finding and developing new customers, markets, or business opportunities. A key concept in sales and business strategy.

examples.japanese: {新規|しんき}{開拓|かいたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To focus on developing new business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}{部|ぶ}→営業部：19381_eigyoubu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The sales department is working on developing new customers.

examples.japanese: {既存|きぞん}⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{維持|いじ}→維持：01624_iji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{新規|しんき}{開拓|かいたく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The balance between maintaining existing customers and developing new ones is important.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard business term, especially in sales and marketing. Can refer to developing new customers, new markets, or new business areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧ (new customer development)
- ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧ (new market development)
- {新規|しんき}{開拓|かいたく}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧ (new business development sales)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}→新規事業：17985_shinkijigyou⟧: new business/venture — refers to starting an entirely new business line rather than finding new customers
